4//! The drop shadow filter.
5
6use crate::third_party::vello_common::color::{AlphaColor, Srgb};
7use crate::third_party::vello_common::filter::gaussian_blur::{MAX_KERNEL_SIZE, plan_decimated_blur, transform_blur_params};
8use crate::third_party::vello_common::filter::transform_offset_params;
9use crate::third_party::vello_common::filter_effects::EdgeMode;
10use crate::third_party::vello_common::kurbo::Affine;
11
12/// A drop shadow filter.
13#[derive(Debug)]
14pub struct DropShadow {
15    /// The x-offset of the shadow.
16    pub dx: f32,
17    /// The y-offset of the shadow.
18    pub dy: f32,
19    /// The color of the shadow.
20    pub color: AlphaColor<Srgb>,
21    /// Standard deviation for the blur (for reference/debugging).
22    pub std_deviation: f32,
23    /// Edge mode for blur sampling.
24    pub edge_mode: EdgeMode,
25    /// Number of 2x2 decimation levels to use (0 means direct convolution).
26    pub n_decimations: usize,
27    /// Pre-computed Gaussian kernel weights for the reduced blur.
28    /// Only the first `kernel_size` elements are valid.
29    pub kernel: [f32; MAX_KERNEL_SIZE],
30    /// Actual length of the kernel (kernel is padded to `MAX_KERNEL_SIZE`).
31    pub kernel_size: u8,
32}
33
34impl DropShadow {
35    /// Create a new drop shadow filter with the specified parameters.
36    ///
37    /// This precomputes the blur decimation plan and kernel for optimal performance.
38    pub fn new(dx: f32, dy: f32, std_deviation: f32, edge_mode: EdgeMode, color: AlphaColor<Srgb>) -> Self {
39        // Precompute blur plan (same logic as GaussianBlur::new)
40        let (n_decimations, kernel, kernel_size) = plan_decimated_blur(std_deviation);
41
42        Self { dx, dy, color, std_deviation, edge_mode, n_decimations, kernel, kernel_size }
43    }
44}
45
46/// Transform a drop shadow's offset and standard deviation using the affine transformation.
47///
48/// Applies the full linear transformation (rotation, scale, and shear) to the offset vector,
49/// and scales the blur standard deviation uniformly.
50///
51/// # Arguments
52/// * `dx` - Horizontal offset in user space
53/// * `dy` - Vertical offset in user space
54/// * `std_deviation` - Blur standard deviation in user space
55/// * `transform` - The transformation matrix to apply
56///
57/// # Returns
58/// A tuple of (`scaled_dx`, `scaled_dy`, `scaled_std_dev`) in device space
59pub(crate) fn transform_shadow_params(dx: f32, dy: f32, std_deviation: f32, transform: &Affine) -> (f32, f32, f32) {
60    let (scaled_dx, scaled_dy) = transform_offset_params(dx, dy, transform);
61
62    // Scale the blur radius uniformly
63    let scaled_std_dev = transform_blur_params(std_deviation, transform);
64
65    (scaled_dx, scaled_dy, scaled_std_dev)
66}
